channel.title: All Out of Tokens
channel.description: Pratik Parashar on AI, finance, and what happens when the two collide.

item.title: The Rebuild: From Three Tabs to Nine, And the One Thing That Surprised Me
item.description: The vfinal of the Variance Commentary Generator. Nine Excel tabs, a transaction trail, a P&L bridge, and the design choice that solved the hallucination problem in a way I didn't see coming.

item.title: The First Build: It Worked, And That's the Problem
item.description: The v1 ran end-to-end. Three Excel tabs, AI-generated commentary, real numbers. So why did I throw it out and start again?

item.title: The Architecture: What the Tool Needs to Do Before Writing a Line of Code
item.description: Before any Python, before any API calls: the input structure, output spec, and prompt decisions that will determine whether this tool actually works.

item.title: Why Writing Variance Commentary Is Still a Manual Job in 2026
item.description: Month-end closes. A spreadsheet with 40 line items. A blank text box where the commentary should go. In 2026, this is still mostly written by hand.

item.title: From India to the Netherlands: The Move That Gave Me My Life Back
item.description: I moved from India to the Netherlands in October 2023. I didn't research the culture. I didn't have a plan. I had 75-hour weeks and enough of them.

item.title: The Controller Role Is Being Redefined. Most Controllers Don't Know It Yet.
item.description: Controller upper-range salaries dropped 21% in a single year. The market is saying something loud. Most people in the role haven't heard it yet.

item.title: Why I Pitched AI Agents to a Big-4 Partner (And What Happened Next)
item.description: A 40-hour job done in 40 minutes. Here's what happened when I actually tried pitching AI agents inside a Big-4 firm.
